title: Revolutionary NIR-activated silicon nanoparticles: precision-controlled release and targeted 3D cancer cell destruction
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4958-4969
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08889A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Vy Anh Tran, Nguyen Huy Hung, Thu Thao Thi Vo, Seong Soo A. An, Sang-Wha Lee, Hun Jeong, Mario A. Tan
This study develops NIR-activated mesoporous silicon NPs for targeted cancer therapy. Functionalized with dieckol and dequalinium, they enable pH-sensitive drug release and enhance chemo-photothermal effects, selectively eliminating cancer cells.
